subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
RECIPIENT_NAME様,
先日の初回入金に関するご連絡に一点補足です。GMO Coin や bitbank との入金者の取り合いが続くなか、市場では中央集権型取引所の獲得単価が1顧客あたり150 USD とされ (出典: growthchain.io/blog/crypto-customer-acquisition-cost)、この水準では浅いインストール最適化のままだと入金まで届かない層に予算が流れます。だからこそ入金イベントそのものへの最適化とインクリメンタリティの計測が、実際の入金者単価を左右します。御社の現在のソース構成と一度比べてみませんか?
angle: fresh angle: market CAC band ($150/customer, sourced) reframes the deposit-CAC stakes vs shallow install optimization
register_notes: Stage 2 ja crypto_and_trading: acknowledges 2nd follow-up + references prior (先日の…ご連絡に補足); fresh angle = market CAC band 150 USD/customer (growthchain, carried verified parent source) reframing deposit-CAC stakes against shallow install optimization; MobUpps incrementality/deposit-optimization referenced with no figure; market number stated as plain value, no hedge; keigo, native cohesion; FSA-licensed JP peers only (GMO Coin/bitbank), no global giant paired with regional prospect; 1 question mark; no sign-off; no em dash, no X-not-Y; unverifiable financemagnates regulatory source removed (no web search permitted); Latin limited to curated acronyms/proper nouns (USD, GMO Coin, bitbank, MobUpps).
